en: No, man, I think something truly fucking fascinating happens when you put yourself in a position of...
zh: 我觉得当你把自己置于这样一个位置时，会发生一些真正令人着迷的事情……

en: I want to solve something...
zh: 就是我想去解决点什么……

en: I got to do something.
zh: 我得去做点什么。

en: and I think everybody has the chance to do so.
zh: 我觉得每个人都有机会去这么做。

en: especially if you're like me and you are not dying of hunger.
zh: 尤其是如果你像我一样，你不愁吃喝。

en: and you know, you have the chance.
zh: 你知道，你是有这个机会的。

en: Look, I'm not gonna sit here and pretend that I don't like to just sit back and relax and not do anything and lie on that bed over there.
zh: 听着，我不会坐在这儿假装自己不喜欢放松、不喜欢什么都不做，躺在那边的床上。

en: but let me tell you, that's not what we're meant for.
zh: 但我告诉你，那不是我们活着的意义。

en: Today I cleaned my kitchen and I did it so well that I'm really proud of myself.
zh: 今天我打扫了厨房，打扫得特别干净，我真的为自己感到骄傲。

en: and I got to actually... There's something about doing the most, you could say, mundane things.
zh: 而且我还意识到……有些事虽然看起来很琐碎、很平常，

en: that kind of you don't want to do.
zh: 你甚至会不想做，

en: I mean, like clean a kitchen or clean your bathroom or sweep the floor or.
zh: 比如清理厨房、清洗浴室、扫地之类的。

en: and it's so profound it can be.
zh: 但这些事，其实挺有意义的。

en: It made me think of you know Home in a way.
zh: 它让我有了一种家的感觉。

en: All the times that my parents would do the cleaning and I was able to just enjoy being a child.
zh: 在家里一直都是父母在做家务，而我只需要享受做个孩子。

en: I might be being corny here, but, you know.
zh: 我可能说得有点煽情，但你懂的。

en: And on the other hand, it was so therapeutic, you know.
zh: 另一方面，它很治愈。

en: It helps. It's not bad. It's nothing bad.
zh: 它有帮助，不是坏事。一点也不坏。

en: It's you know, you got to do something.
zh: 你知道的，你得去做点事。

en: It's not you know... I'm not reinventing the wheel here.
zh: 这又不是说……我也没重复造轮子做没意义的事。

en: It's good if you do something hard.
zh: 如果你去做一件困难的事，那是好事。

en: Where do you start?
zh: 那你该从哪开始？

en: How do you take action?
zh: 你该怎么采取行动？

en: Well, I think you need to start accepting the fact that you're not there yet.
zh: 我觉得你得先接受一个事实：你现在还没到那一步。

en: And that's okay, you know.
zh: 但这没关系，你懂的。

en: You need to start accepting yourself for who you are.
zh: 你得开始接纳真正的自己。

en: and once you do, you can start accepting the reality that it is within your hands to say fuck this.
zh: 一旦你做到了，你就能接受这样的现实：你是有能力说“去他妈的，我不要这样了”。

en: And I want to change.
zh: “我想改变。”

en: Fuck this and I want to dream big and I want to change who I am.
zh: “去他的，我想要大胆梦想，我想改变自己。”

en: Oh, that's actually pretty good.
zh: 这个还挺好吃的。

en: Look at that, isn't that magnificent.
zh: 你看，这个景色好看吧。
